summary: Attackers posing as cryptocurrency recruiters on LinkedIn conducted a fake interview process and delivered a malicious GitHub repository containing scripts that executed during installation and editor interaction to establish remote access and exfiltrate system data. When malware execution failed the attackers attempted to redirect the victim to a wallet draining website.
user_mistake: Executed or considered executing untrusted code from an unverified recruiter during a job process
prevention: Analyze recruiter supplied code in isolated environments/Never run unfamiliar repositories on machines holding sensitive assets
